common.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Gear inventory, packing lists and production plans.
auth.stale: Your session is no longer valid (the account was removed or the database was reset). Sign in again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.outNowBody: Items on projects or rented out, grouped by where they are.
dashboard.attentionEmpty: Nothing is in repair or missing.
dashboard.emptyBody: Start by adding categories and models, then the physical items you own.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.trackingHelp: Serialized: one record per physical unit. Bulk: tracked by quantity (cables, clamps). Cannot change once items exist.
inventory.linksHelp: One per line: Label | https://url, or just a URL.
inventory.isKit: This item is a kit or case that contains other items
inventory.isKitHelp: Packing a kit packs its contents. Contents follow the kit's status and location.
inventory.noModelsBody: A model is a catalogue entry: manufacturer, model name and specs, entered once. Items are the physical units.
inventory.noItemsBody: Add items from a model page, or change the filters.
inventory.noItemsForModel: No items of this model yet
inventory.countHelp: Creates one record per unit, each with its own asset tag.
inventory.serialNumbersHelp: Optional, one per line in the same order as the units.
inventory.reasonHelp: Required for repair, missing and retired.
inventory.addToKitHelp: Search by asset tag, serial number or model.
inventory.qrHelp: Scanning this opens the item page.
inventory.noCategoriesBody: Categories group models: Video › Projectors › Laser projectors.
inventory.modelsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no models} one {# model} other {# models}}
inventory.noLocationsBody: Locations are warehouse zones and shelves, repair shops, and later projects and renters.
inventory.itemsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no items} one {# item} other {# items}}
inventory.deleteItemConfirm: Delete this item and its history? This cannot be undone.
inventory.cascadeNote: Applies to the kit and everything in it.
inventory.notForRentalHelp: Only for our own projects. It cannot be put on a rental.
inventory.personHelp: A colleague or a contact. Items at this location are with that person.

scan.title: Scan
scan.hint: Point the camera at an asset tag. The item page opens automatically.
scan.cameraError: The camera could not be started.
scan.notOurs: That code is not a Vertigo Gear tag.
scan.insecure: The camera only works over HTTPS (or on localhost).
scan.insecureHelp: Open the app through its https:// address. For local testing on a phone, start the dev server with npm run dev:https.
scan.unsupported: This browser does not support camera access.
scan.denied: Camera permission was denied. Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings and try again.
scan.noCamera: No camera found on this device.
scan.inUse: The camera is in use by another app or tab.

settings.title: Settings
settings.usersHelp: Who can sign in and what they may do.
settings.customFieldsHelp: Add your own fields to models, items, projects and rentals.
settings.name: Name
settings.roleHelp: Admin: everything incl. users. Member: edit gear, projects, lists, plans. Viewer: read-only.
settings.googleEmailHelp: Used to invite the user to calendar events.
settings.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters. Share it with the user; they can change it under Settings › Your account.
settings.apiTokensHelp: Use a token as a Bearer header to call the REST API from other tools. Docs at /api/docs.
settings.tokenCreated: Token created. Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
settings.cfKeyHelp: Lowercase identifier used in exports and the API, e.g. lamp_hours. Cannot change later.
settings.noCustomFieldsBody: Extra fields appear on the entity's forms, pages, filters and exports.
settings.deleteFieldConfirm: Delete this field? Existing values stay in the database but are no longer shown.
settings.webhooksHelp: Send a signed POST to your own URL when something happens.
settings.calendarHelp: Feed links and Google Calendar push.
settings.webhookSecretHelp: Used to sign the body: X-Vertigo-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, body).
settings.webhookEventsHelp: Leave all unchecked to receive every event.
settings.noWebhooksBody: Webhooks let other tools react to changes without code changes here.
settings.outboxHelp: Webhook deliveries and calendar syncs waiting, done or failed.
settings.contactsHelp: People and companies who are not users: borrowers, suppliers, partners, key-fob holders.
settings.cfCategoryHelp: Only models or items in this category (and its sub-categories) get the field. Leave empty for all.

comingSoon.title: Coming in Phase {phase}
comingSoon.body: This section is planned but not built yet. The navigation is here so the layout stays stable.

projects.title: Projects
projects.datesHelp: The reservation window is the earliest to the latest of these dates.
projects.linksHelp: One per line: Label | https://url (Drive, Notion, …).
projects.noProjectsBody: Create a project to reserve gear for its dates.
projects.noProjectsYetBody: A project reserves gear for a date range and holds crew, contacts and later packing lists and the production plan.
projects.crewCount: {count, plural, =0 {no crew} one {# crew} other {# crew}}
projects.reservationsCount: {count, plural, =0 {nothing reserved} one {# reservation} other {# reservations}}
projects.reservationsHelp: Reservations are per model. Specific units are assigned when packing (Phase 3).
projects.conflictBody: Only {available} of {requested} available in that period ({shortfall} short). Reserved elsewhere:
projects.itemsOnSite: {count, plural, =0 {No items on site} one {# item on site} other {# items on site}}
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete this project and its reservations? This cannot be undone.
projects.noClientsBody: Clients are the companies you work for and rent to.
projects.projectsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no projects} one {# project} other {# projects}}
projects.rentalsCount: {count, plural, =0 {no rentals} one {# rental} other {# rentals}}

rentals.title: Rentals
rentals.noRentalsBody: A rental reserves gear for an external client in the same availability system as projects.
rentals.noLines: No gear on this rental yet.
rentals.assignHelp: Optional for serialized models: pick the exact unit that goes out. It moves to the renter when handed out.
rentals.markOutConfirm: Hand the gear out? Assigned units move to the renter.
rentals.markReturnedConfirm: Mark everything returned? Assigned units go back to their home location.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Projects and rentals on a timeline. Red marks days where a model is over-booked.
calendar.feedsHelp: Subscribe to these in Google Calendar (Other calendars › From URL) or Apple Calendar. Anyone with the link can read the feed; rotate it if it leaks.
calendar.rotateConfirm: Rotate this link? Calendars using the old link stop updating.
calendar.googleOn: Configured. Confirmed projects and rentals are pushed to the shared calendars.
calendar.googleOff: Not configured. Set GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID_PROJECTS (see README).

packing.title: Packing lists
packing.name: Name
packing.noListsBody: A packing list turns reservations into what actually goes in the truck, with check-out and check-in.
packing.noLinesBody: Add gear from the catalog, add a whole kit, apply a template or pull in the project's reservations.
packing.packHint: Tick what goes in the truck. Scan a tag to tick a specific unit.
packing.stillToPack: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} still to pack
packing.checkOutConfirm: Check out {packed} packed units? They move to the project; unpacked lines stay on the list as not packed.
packing.checkInHint: Tick what came back. Mark anything damaged or missing. Finish when the truck is empty.
packing.finishConfirm: Finish? Anything still out ({count}) is marked missing.
packing.shareHelp: Anyone with this link can read the list, no login. Revoke it when the job is done.
packing.noTemplatesBody: Templates are reusable lists: "Standard laser show", "2× projector mapping rig".
packing.templateLines: {count, plural, =0 {no lines} one {# line} other {# lines}}
packing.onSiteNote: Checked-out gear is at the project location until it is checked in.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.name: Name
contacts.noContactsBody: Add the people and companies you lend gear to, buy from, or rent in from.

plans.title: Production plan
plans.createPlanHelp: Start empty or from a template. Template entries are dated relative to the anchor day.
plans.noPlanBody: Schedule, tasks, crew, logistics and day sheets for this project.
plans.planSummary: {schedule} schedule entries · {done} / {tasks} tasks done · {logistics} logistics entries
plans.anchorHelp: Day 0 of the template, normally load-in. Entries on day -1 land the day before.
plans.applyTemplateHelp: Adds the template's entries to this plan. Nothing is removed.
plans.saveAsTemplateHelp: Stores every entry relative to the anchor day so it can be applied to another project.
plans.deleteConfirm: Delete the whole production plan? Schedule, tasks and logistics go with it.
plans.shareHelp: Anyone with this link can read the plan and its day sheets, no login. Revoke it when the job is done.
plans.removeEntryConfirm: Remove this entry from the schedule?
plans.noCrew: No crew or contacts on the project yet.
plans.logisticsHelp: Addresses, booking numbers, door codes, dock height, who to call.
plans.noPackingLists: No packing lists on this project yet.
plans.templatesHelp: Reusable schedules, tasks and logistics, relative to the load-in day.
plans.noTemplatesBody: Save a finished plan as a template, or build one here entry by entry.
plans.templateEntryHelp: Entries are relative to the anchor day: 0 = load-in, -1 = the day before, 2 = two days after.
plans.noDocuments: No documents yet. Riders, stage plots, drawings, risk assessments, 3D models.
plans.documentsHelp: Any file type. Images, PDFs and glTF/GLB/OBJ/STL open in the browser; SketchUp, DWG, DXF, Vectorworks, AI and PSD are stored for download, and a GLB export of the same model uploaded next to it gives an inline 3D view. Uploading a file with the same name adds a version.
plans.newVersionHint: Upload a file named "{name}" to add a version.
plans.deleteDocumentConfirm: Delete this document with all its versions and markup?
plans.noViewer: No viewer for this file type.
plans.nativeHint: Native formats (SketchUp, DWG, DXF, Vectorworks, AI, PSD) are stored for download. Upload a preview image here, or a GLB export as its own document for an inline 3D view.
plans.measureHint: Tap two points on the model.
plans.pdfDocsSkipped: PDF drawings need poppler on the server to appear here; see the document list.
